# ZoomLevel

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Defines the default zoom level when a PDF is opened

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `FitPage`: Fit the entire page within the window
- `FitWidth`: Fit the page width within the window
- `FitHeight`: Fit the page height within the window
- `Custom`: Use a custom zoom level
